title: Gate 3: passes as specified, and is not a discriminator

gate.statistic: fraction of TOKENS in documents >= 2048 tokens

the_problem: The same statistic on the UNCHANGED shipped corpus (artifacts/tokens-v4) is 0.5587, which also passes. The gate cannot distinguish the new corpus from the old one, so it supplies no evidence for the re-weighting this branch performed.

spec_premise_refuted.claim: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-31-long-context-corpus-design.md: 'A 2048-token training window therefore holds on the order of eighteen unrelated documents.'
spec_premise_refuted.derived_from: the MEDIAN document length (112 tokens), a document-weighted statistic
spec_premise_refuted.verdict: REFUTED on the corpus the model actually trained on. The median 2048-token window already contained zero document boundaries.

why_the_spec_was_wrong.cause_1: The table was measured over 'the first 40M tokens' -- 11.3% of the array. Reproduced exactly from that prefix (mean 1030, median 112, p75/p90/p95 223/404/609, docs>=2048 1.08%), confirming the prefix is the source of the figures.
why_the_spec_was_wrong.cause_2: Separator density varies 501x across deciles of tokens-v4 because blend_corpus.py emits sources sequentially. No prefix of this array is representative.
why_the_spec_was_wrong.cause_3: The table reported DOCUMENT fractions; the gate thresholds TOKEN fractions. The same 40M prefix already showed 83.02% of tokens in documents >=2048 -- the gate's own statistic, never computed, already far above its 40% threshold.

what_the_reweighting_did_buy.note: Real and measured, roughly halving cross-document contamination per window. But it is an improvement to a corpus that was already majority-clean by token mass, not a fix for a corpus that 'cannot teach long context'.

what_still_stands: The spec's fact 1 -- probe_context_use.py shows per-token loss flat from position ~64 to 511 -- is untouched by this and remains true. What is refuted is document fragmentation as its MECHANISM. That mechanism is again unisolated.
limitations: Window sampling is uniform over token positions with a fixed seed (0), n=200,000 windows per corpus; it does not model the trainer's own batch sampler.
No model was trained or evaluated here. This is a corpus measurement only.
tokens-v3 and tokens-v4 were read but never written.
